name: h2o-lightning-4b
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B (config.json max_position_embeddings 262144). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: Inherited unchanged from Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B: 8 full GQA layers (kv heads 4, head_dim 256) and 24 other layers, per the base config.json.
notes:
ADDED 2026-10-30 from the trending sweep, step 4b, task=decision. A DECISION model, not a text generator: it reads a record (text/JSON, plus images) and a schema of typed questions - choice, yes/no (noul), score, box - and returns a probability per option in ONE forward pass, zero output tokens. Excluded from the worth-running ranking by construction. Fine-tune of Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B; architecture inherited unchanged from models/qwen3-5-4b.

PARAMS: HF safetensors total 4,659,865,088 = 4.66B, identical to the base. The card says the weights are 9.3 GB and were measured on one NVIDIA L40S (48 GB) - that is the bf16 file size, not a parameter count. HARDWARE GATE: passes (active 4.66B <= 40; 4.66 x 0.5 GiB = ~2.3 GiB at 4-bit). 

EVIDENCE CAVEATS, and they matter here: (1) the two Decision Index numbers are SELF-MEASURED on edition 0.3, while data/decision_index.jsonl is edition 0.4.1 (balanced_skill) - this model is NOT on the 0.4.1 upstream board (data/index.json generated 2026-10-29T14:04:16Z, 247 models, engines: no h2o-lightning-4b row; the 31B sibling h2o-lightning-31b-v1.1 is there at 68.64). So do NOT rank 63.21 against those rows. (2) The ImageJevBench 66.58 IS a board read (benchmarkheaven.com/image-jev-bench, edition v0.3.0, page read 2026-10-29), not H2O's own run. (3) The JevBench figure is 206/231 items converted to a percentage by me, and the JevBench board itself lists v1.4.1's composite 75.98 WITHOUT a rank because its draw is not equated to the reference scale. (4) It needs a patched vLLM build for the recommended two-way reading; stock vLLM 0.30.0 scores 202/231 instead of 206/231.

benchmarks.name: Decision Index 0.3 text index
benchmarks.config: SELF-MEASURED by H2O.ai with the Decision Index 0.3 kit's own scorer over the full 140,178-row text run, v1.4.2 default profile (PROFILE=di gives 63.64). A DIFFERENT EDITION from the catalog's decision_index.jsonl rows, which are Decision Index 0.4.1 (balanced_skill). The model is NOT on the 0.4.1 upstream board (spaces/multimodalart/jev-decision-index data/index.json, generated 2026-10-29T14:04:16Z, 247 models), so this number must not be ranked against those rows.

benchmarks.name: Decision Index 0.3 vision index
benchmarks.config: Card 'Measured' table, same kit run, 12,210 public vision rows. Same edition caveat as the text index: Decision Index 0.3, not 0.4.1.

benchmarks.name: ImageJevBench Composite (edition v0.3.0)
benchmarks.config: Board read, NOT H2O's own run: benchmarkheaven.com/image-jev-bench edition v0.3.0, page read 2026-10-29, the board's ranked run of the same weights (release v1.4.1) measured 2026-10-27 with images at temperature 0.65 and v1.4.1's image cap. #1 of 46 open-weight Jev-class models, #2 of 55 including API systems (the one ahead is an API system at 75.38). Sub-scores as printed: Intelligence 55.39, Calibration 76.92, Speed 88.71, Cost 56.32, Capability 66.16.

benchmarks.name: JevBench 231 public items correct (share)
benchmarks.config: 206 of 231 correct on JevBench's own CLI, v1.4.2 default (two-way reading); one-way reading scores 202/231. Card-reported rate converted to a percentage of items (206/231 = 89.18), not a score the board printed. The board (v1.7.15, read 2026-10-28) lists v1.4.1's composite 75.98 WITHOUT a rank because its draw is not yet equated to the board's reference scale.
